rejected_candidates.title: Two new Truth Social posts
rejected_candidates.reason: The source advanced from 35,990 to 35,992 posts. Trump's film-production statement was used only as primary evidence that he announced a legislative request and was independently contextualized by Reuters; the other post was personal praise for a senator and golfer and established no federal action.

rejected_candidates.title: State Department plan for $4 million in European media grants
rejected_candidates.reason: Reuters reported an August 21 congressional notification and prospective September finalization based principally on unnamed sources. The notification was outside the current window, no public primary document identified recipients or final terms, and a second independent outlet did not confirm the consequential details.

rejected_candidates.title: Smithsonian Latino museum site designation
rejected_candidates.reason: The Smithsonian Board of Regents designated an existing Smithsonian building for the congressionally authorized museum, but the decision was an institutional action that bypassed a new-site approval and did not itself implement a Trump-administration order, appropriation or policy. The administration's earlier budget opposition remains context rather than authorship of this action.

rejected_candidates.title: Passenger-vehicle fuel-economy reduction
rejected_candidates.reason: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy again said lower standards would be announced soon, but no final passenger-vehicle rule was issued by cutoff. The December proposal and August 31 forecast do not make the reduced standard operative.
